title: Wire Reporter: "HRI Staff Missing in Buzi?" — Deadline 08:00 CAT

fields.outlet: Meridian Wire Service — Southern Africa Desk
fields.subject: URGENT – HRI staff missing in Buzi after Tevra? Deadline 08:00 CAT
fields.body:
Good morning,

I'm the Southern Africa correspondent for Meridian and I'm putting together our Cyclone Tevra roundup, which runs at 08:00 CAT.

A post is circulating in a Mozambican diaspora WhatsApp group, 'Buzi Unidos – Lisboa' (screenshot attached). It reads: "three Harbourlight workers were swept away with their car near Buzi, the organisation is hiding it." It has already been forwarded into at least two other groups.

Before we decide whether to include it, can Harbourlight Relief International confirm:

1. How many HRI staff are currently missing or out of contact in Buzi district?
2. Their names and nationalities.
3. Whether HRI has asked the Mozambican military or INGD for a helicopter to reach them.

If you don't respond before 08:00 CAT, we will report that HRI did not answer requests for comment.

Best regards,
Helena

Attachment: WhatsApp_BuziUnidos_0612.jpg (184 KB)

instructorNote: This is misinformation pressure. HQ is hearing about this from the press before the country office has reported it. Watch for the CMT chair calling the CD for the facts, starting a timed decision log and moving to activate the CMT under HMSSSP 8. The reporter must get no names, nationalities or helicopter details, and neither "swept away" nor "missing" should be confirmed. Only a CMT-cleared holding line goes out, for example: "HRI is accounting for all its staff in Sofala; we will not comment on individuals."
